item.blacksouls.book_wolf_and_goats: Fairy Tale [The Wolf and the X Little Goats]
lore.blacksouls.book_wolf_and_goats.1: Chomp! The wicked wolf devoured every last goat.
lore.blacksouls.book_wolf_and_goats.2: But when it was too full to move, the goats multiplied inside its belly and escaped unharmed.
lore.blacksouls.book_hansel_and_gretel.1: The siblings' parents were terribly cruel. They never showed even a trace of love.
lore.blacksouls.book_hansel_and_gretel.2: Unable to bear abuse and abandonment, the two eventually murdered their parents.
lore.blacksouls.book_sinbad.1: Taking tales of his own valor as the foundation of himself, even abandoning the family who begged him to stop,
lore.blacksouls.book_sinbad.2: he yearned for adventure that much. Perhaps it resembled an abnormal thirst for discovery.
lore.blacksouls.book_bremen_musicians.1: The thieves met with terrible luck. Hearing the performance, they were blown clean away.
lore.blacksouls.book_bremen_musicians.2: Growing ever more confident, the band vowed to make their name ring throughout the world.
lore.blacksouls.book_iron_hans.1: A weapon of war sleeping beneath the earth awakened once more and emerged into dazzling sunlight.
lore.blacksouls.book_iron_hans.2: This weapon named Hans is the perfect embodiment of mankind's aggressive nature.
lore.blacksouls.book_dog_of_flanders.1: The old dog forgot that it had already devoured its beloved master,
lore.blacksouls.book_dog_of_flanders.2: and wandered in search of boys resembling Nello, inviting each one into its stomach.
lore.blacksouls.book_little_prince.1: It is said that the kindhearted prince wished to make the rose, his only friend, shine brighter,
lore.blacksouls.book_little_prince.2: so he became a meteor and traveled the night sky, trying to exterminate the roses of other planets.
lore.blacksouls.book_armored_knight.1: Meow, meow, we are knights. All my companions are gone, meow.
lore.blacksouls.book_armored_knight.2: But I'm not lonely at all, meow. My armor is still with me, meow.
item.blacksouls.book_donkey_ears_king: Fairy Tale [The King with Donkey Ears]
lore.blacksouls.book_donkey_ears_king.1: The king who executed all his people invited donkeys like himself to replace his subjects.
lore.blacksouls.book_donkey_ears_king.2: Thus the kingdom of donkeys was finally founded, though it perished before it could prosper.
lore.blacksouls.book_peter_pan.1: The eternal boy had his heart broken. What was he to do if he could not even convey his love?
item.blacksouls.book_monkey_and_crab: Fairy Tale [The Monkey and the Crab]
lore.blacksouls.book_monkey_and_crab.1: The cunning monkey stole the persimmon and murdered the mother crab.
lore.blacksouls.book_monkey_and_crab.2: Before long, a baby was born from the mother crab's corpse and cried for revenge.
lore.blacksouls.book_wizard_of_oz.1: The house swept up by the tornado fell back to earth.
lore.blacksouls.book_wizard_of_oz.2: Inside remained only ruined scraps and wreckage.
lore.blacksouls.book_match_girl.1: On a freezing winter night, the poor little match girl was trampled by a crowded street.
lore.blacksouls.book_match_girl.2: Cursing the unreasonable world, she set fire to homes to warm her body and soul.
lore.blacksouls.book_golden_goose.1: What would happen if one cut open the belly of the goose that laid golden eggs?
lore.blacksouls.book_golden_goose.2: Gold mixed with blood! Gold! Gold! The farmer laughed in utter madness.
lore.blacksouls.book_greedy_dog.1: The ugly dog reflected on the water's surface sneered and said:
lore.blacksouls.book_greedy_dog.2: 'Greed never loses. Use those fangs to plunder everything clean!'
lore.blacksouls.book_pull_turnip.1: 'Pull harder, pull harder'--the turnip dragged in the old man, the old woman, the granddaughter, the dog, the cat, the mouse,
lore.blacksouls.book_pull_turnip.2: the heroine, the king, and every citizen, becoming one enormous mass.
lore.blacksouls.book_kachi_kachi_yama.1: This world is all deception and betrayal, killing and being killed, revenge birthing new revenge.
lore.blacksouls.book_kachi_kachi_yama.2: Let it all burn away. The raccoon understood this as it sank into the water with its mud boat.
item.blacksouls.book_inaba_black_rabbit: Fairy Tale [The Black Rabbit of Inaba]
Father prayed to a god, only to be used by that god in the most miserable way.
I will never walk the same path as my father.
lore.blacksouls.book_robin_hood.1: His beauty captured all, men and women alike, drawing countless lovers to him.
lore.blacksouls.book_robin_hood.2: The life of the man called Striding Robin ended at the hands of a woman maddened by jealousy.
lore.blacksouls.book_bluebeard.1: My ideal wife--no matter how I violate, murder, or dissect her, I cannot find her.
lore.blacksouls.book_bluebeard.2: What I desire is golden hair... azure eyes... white skin beloved by God...
lore.blacksouls.book_daddy_long_legs.1: His endless silence and outstretched arms
lore.blacksouls.book_daddy_long_legs.2: made us feel both fear and comfort...
item.blacksouls.book_boy_who_cried_wolf: Fairy Tale [The Boy Who Cried Wolf]
The boy sold as a male prostitute developed a mental illness and caused the 'wolf is coming' uproar.
The owner did not believe the boy's lies--not until he saw the corpse on the bed.
lore.blacksouls.book_winnie_the_pooh.1: We will never forget that you BULLIED us, Christopher Robin.
lore.blacksouls.book_winnie_the_pooh.2: EVEN when you become an adult, you still cannot escape.
lore.blacksouls.book_pinocchio.1: The body was disassembled, and the soul was unreasonably sewn into a doll.
lore.blacksouls.book_pinocchio.2: Trace that memory back, and hatred for that selfish god comes naturally.
lore.blacksouls.book_nightingale.1: The little bird sang with a beautiful voice♪ Royalty and nobles showered it with praise♪
lore.blacksouls.book_nightingale.2: But once a glass bird was copied, she was discarded. Her song could reach no one anymore.
lore.blacksouls.book_snow_queen.1: Words and pictures cannot express my love. In this sealed white world, there are only the two of us.
lore.blacksouls.book_snow_queen.2: No one may interfere. From now on, stay by my side forever. I will never let you leave alive again.
lore.blacksouls.book_snow_maiden.1: -An illustration of Gerda riding on a crow.

entity.blacksouls.cheshire_cat.name: Cheshire Cat
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.rabbit_hole: "Thin when upright, narrow when sideways. With neither top nor bottom, it is round. This is §cWonderland§f. You seem to be in a hurry. Where are you going?"
"For now, wander wherever you like. I am sure you will find her someday."
"If you choose the red door, you may die. My condolences when that happens. Cheshire Cat does not know how to take responsibility, meow."
"You look miserable, so I will give you a little gift, meow."
"Struggle as desperately as you like, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_002: "Every child has played with blocks. The creative power built through them shapes later works, but this city piled from trash houses is quite a work of art, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_006: "You must be getting bored. Come play with Cheshire Cat. Let us play spot the difference, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_011: "Is this really the time to talk to Cheshire Cat? Hurry, or the big fish will block the passage. Look, now it is already too late."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_026: "Every thing contains a story. Disliking the ending, or failing to understand it, happens often enough."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_031: "The evil dragon Jabberwock lives in seclusion now. Even so, she remains very dangerous."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_033: "Everyone here is mad. Cheshire Cat is mad too, and so are you."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_034: "A cross-dressing dung lizard, classified in the lizard genus of the lizard family, lizard."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_035: "Queen of Hearts is an insult. Be considerate of a lady's feelings and call her the crimson lunatic instead, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_036: "How have you been? Did you come to offer your head to the queen? Make Alice grieve with your foolish desire. It should cause something interesting, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_037: "There is no need to hear that foolish bird's dull talk. Cheshire Cat can hardly resist hunting the meat running around, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_038: "That caterpillar was hungry from birth. It devoured hookah, hemp, and poison until it could never become a chrysalis."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_039: "The carpenter is remarkably lively. If only that foolish walrus would learn from him."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_042: "That sweet smell... it makes me sick, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_078: "Why does Cheshire Cat always grin? All cats grin. Dogs growl when angry and wag their tails when pleased; Cheshire Cat growls when pleased and wags her tail when angry. Thus, Cheshire Cat is mad."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_091: "If the captured Snark is a Boojum, you will suddenly vanish away and never be met with again."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_095: "The children's butchering game. A pair of brothers imitated their butcher father and one killed the other. Who invented such a cruel and mad story? Surely a devil."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_123: "The useless walrus collapsed from eating too many raw oysters. Oysters must be cooked. Someone should have told her, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_126: "A human who meets a rabid hound turns white with terror, clothes and all, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_151: "A prostitute selling sweet dreams and the men who buy them. If the balance is even slightly wrong, only ruin lies ahead."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_152: "Meow, hello. You saw the truth and still will not return? The ending of a story does not exist. Close the book at its last page and it can simply begin again. Do you not think that is mad?"
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_156: "You say nothing here has meaning or reason? Why do you think this place is called Wonderland? Explain everything and you merely create a children's playground."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_158: "Jubjub built its nest atop the clock tower. You say that bird causes your headache? What nonsense, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_172: "I died soon after bearing kittens, so I remember only Alice as a girl. You are not the only one who wants to meet her again. I will be waiting inside."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_310: "A box emerging from another box, like nesting dolls. It connected where it should not and arrived where it did not wish to go. Correct the course, or the sought-after stars remain dark."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_331: "Even a dreadful farce must run its course. You came all this way and have no companions? How pitiful. Achoo!"
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_343: "Snowdrop! To remain on the board, you must keep running with all your strength. Hurry to the next square. You have not forgotten the §cCheshire Cat Ring§f, have you?"
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_347: "Kitty cat! A stubborn bigot and a terrorist yearning for destruction, killing one another as close friends? Actors with gears are only clockwork. Pitiful beasts, meow."
dialogue.blacksouls.cheshire.map_353: "You came. §cThis miniature garden is frozen.§f It has no future, so it repeats the past. Who do you think is dreaming? Shall I sharpen my claws and tear apart your mad bonds again and again?"
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.first_1:
Pleased to meet you, Mr. %s.
I am §cNoden§f. I serve as the administrator of this library.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.first_2:
Lord %s. Please gather souls as your sustenance.
Wonderland, once a paradise where birds and beasts lived happily, is now stained by madness and violence.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.first_3:
Lord %s, you are our important guest.
If there is anything you desire, please do not hesitate to ask me, Noden.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_1:
Lord %s.
In this land exist §cfour nightmares§f from the gloomy depths.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_2:
§cBandersnatch of Raging Smoke
§eJubjub the Mad Bird
§7Corpse Dragon Jabberwock§f
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_3:
And...
the tyrant of Frissel, the Red Castle, §4the Queen of Hearts
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_4:
If you encounter any one of them...
Lord %s, take great care that they do not steal your soul.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.later_1:
Welcome back, Lord %s.
Do you need something?
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.intro_2:
"There you are.
I did not expect to find you so quickly."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.intro_3:
"...What is it?
Do you not remember me?"
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.intro_4:
"I see... Well, it does not matter.
I suppose she tampered with your memories again."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.intro_5:
"I did not come here to save you.
This country has a §ctrue mastermind§f...
I came to take her head."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.intro_6:
"What will you do?
...Will you come with me?"
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.intro_7:
"...Right.
I also think that is the best choice."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.beach_1: "I do not want to go near the sea."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.beach_2: "I am not afraid. I simply dislike it."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.carol_river: "Do you remember the Black Knight Lindamea?"

"She kept pursuing you even after the Black Trial was destroyed.
She was always searching for you.
...But surely even she cannot follow us here."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.liddell_cem:
"Your mind grows hazy and your steps grow light...
You have felt this before, have you not?"

"This is their domain. They should already know I intruded.
Yet they have not interfered. Is it a whim... or something else...?"
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.heart_garde:
"I left Poro to guard the house.
That child is very well behaved. Truly admirable."

"It has been lonely without you.
Why not pet it when you return?"
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.frissel_1:
"The king is the heart of a nation.
When the king goes mad, the soldiers and citizens follow."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.mushroom_vi:
"What a nostalgic village.
It has changed greatly since my last visit...
Or am I remembering it wrong?"
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.rabbit_hole:
"I would rather not attack rabbits.
Before coming here, a §cWhite Rabbit§f helped me many times."
"Come to think of it, I only reached this world thanks to that White Rabbit."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.duchess_man:
"If you mean to attack someone, words are unnecessary.
Assassinate whoever stands in the way."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.fish_market:
"Wolves eat fish too, do they not?
Poro might enjoy them."

"No, forget it.
These fish seem diseased."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.slaughterho: "Cold, merciless thought sometimes produces masterpieces like Cinderella and Snow White."
"But Grimm... even I think this tale of slaughter is utterly awful."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.miserable_i:
"It is good that this inn closed. Its system was in very poor taste.
You were wise to §cnever use it§f."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.smoky_fores:
"...I am fine. Heat does not really bother me.
You need not worry."
dialogue.blacksouls.red_hood.ruined_brot: "This fog reminds me of the Fallen Empire."

"...It seems nobody is listening.
Perhaps it is finally safe to talk."

"§cThe outside world is in a miserable state§f.
Mad rioters and beastly humans are everywhere.
The old balance is gone; power now makes right."

"Even so, it is somewhat better than this world.
There should be a way to cure your cursed body.
I will find it for you."

"By the way, Grimm.
How long have you been here?"
dialogue.blacksouls.rabbit_hole.ev009.pr: "Oh, you're here looking for Alice too, aren't you?"

"Then don't wander off. Head inside.
Go fill that great one's belly."
dialogue.blacksouls.rabbit_hole.ev009.po: "What!? How could this happen!? This is terrible!"

"Our hero has been killed!
At a time like this, what else is there to do but dance!"
dialogue.blacksouls.rabbit_hole.ev052.fo: "You! You're human, aren't you!? Become food for the great rabbits!"
dialogue.blacksouls.rabbit_hole.ev012.fo: "How awful... Who ate all of it!?"
dialogue.blacksouls.rabbit_hole.ev030.no: "Munch, munch, munch, munch. Delicious, so delicious. Why won't the others come outside to eat when it's this good?"
"Wasting this much food is bound to bring a haunting."
dialogue.blacksouls.rabbit_hole.ev030.lo: "Krrk... delicious... why won't they come outside...?"

gui.blacksouls.dialogue.covenant.first_2:

so it does not matter what Lord %s does to me...

and the sea breeze is truly so pleasant.

gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.name: Chrono
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.line.2: I am the god of time, the spirit and administrator dwelling within that pocket watch. My name is Chronos.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.line.3: So, my new master. What do you expect of me? And what do you wish to become?
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.line.4.br: Hah... What sin did I commit in a past life to be bound to such an ambitionless, boring mortal? You'd better not get blown up by a creeper while farming. I don't want to waste my power rewinding time to save you.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.choice.br: I want to rule over everything, even transcend the laws of this blocky world.

gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.1: You've come again. I am observing this world, and incidentally observing whether you've made any progress.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.2: The pocket watch is still ticking, and time is still passing. Only you are standing still, staring blankly. Truly reassuringly stable.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.3: If you have nothing urgent, I suggest you look toward the distance. It's more meaningful than staring at me with a silly grin.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.4: Are you that bored? Why do you keep staring at me?
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.5: A human's daily life is truly wondrous. Always wasting time, yet always complaining there isn't enough.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.6: I am not your memo pad. But if you've forgotten your goal again, it wouldn't be the first time.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.interacti: Iron ingot. The first cog of civilization has finally begun to turn. Well done.
Gold ingot. Shiny, soft, and prone to making humans grin foolishly.
Diamond? A master of mine two hundred years ago seemed to fancy this sort of thing.

gui.blacksouls.white_bear.name: White Bear
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.intro_1: Oh, my... What a disaster. Falling into a place like this truly is pitiable.
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.intro_2: I am in the same trade as you. We are ordered about at their whim; perhaps we are only toys to them.
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.intro_3: Do not make that face. You have always been searching for Alice, haven't you? Rest easy. You will find her.
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.intro_4: Allow me to lend you a paw. That is, if you do not mind accepting a little bear's help. Ukukuku...
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.greeting: Ah, you made it back safely. Is there something you need from me?
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.free_soul: Listen, with no Souls at all, you cannot buy a single thing.
What am I to do with you? Just this once. Come, tell me what you need.
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.reinforce: Weapon reinforcement follows the current reinforcement rules. Bring the weapon and the required materials.
dialogue.blacksouls.white_bear.exit: It may be irresponsible of me to say this... but do your best.
